subject: [PATCH v5 8/8] mm/gup: batch contiguous same-folio PTEs into one refcount grab

2026-11-16.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the handling of large folios (mTHP) in the Linux kernel's memory management system by batching contiguous PTEs into one refcount grab, reducing the number of try_grab_folio() calls and improving performance. The patch introduces a new function gup_pte_batch_len() to determine how many PTEs can be committed as one run, and modifies the follow_page_pte() function to use this information. This change is particularly beneficial for large folios, where it reduces the time taken by 24.2 times compared to the previous implementation.
